behavior: sticky native horizontal carousel with fixed Todos and side arrows; no autoplay or looping
complete authenticated catalog; unknown or failed continuations never produce a partial list
stable channel IDs with canonical URL aliases; menu and description links are never treated as owners
sidebar subscription identities lead the order; remaining channels retain catalog order
the first explicit selection after mount refreshes the native feed; later switches reuse the indexed grid
a bidirectional channel-to-card index makes filter switches proportional to the changed visible sets rather than the whole grid
owner reads are cached ephemerally by card/video/link/author-text/avatar signature and invalidated by late collaboration metadata or card recycling
pagination indexes only added roots, runs at most five native pages per round and stops when the viewport is filled
selection survives SPA navigation; account change, reload and disabling reset it
unknown owner cards are excluded during selection; Shorts and relevant preferences remain authoritative
disabling disconnects the channel DOM scanner and removes controller observers, UI and filter markers
independent document_idle content script and CSS bundle; core features never import carousel code
theme-aware fallback palette follows html[dark], reserves block flow plus 24px and stays below native overlays
catalog loading/errors live in the header; video pagination status and retry live after the grid
refresh validates account and richGridRenderer data before the local MAIN bridge updates the existing native grid
guide ordering failure never invalidates a complete catalog; rendered sidebar order remains authoritative
newness mirrors native sidebar dots and acknowledges locally in memory for 30 minutes
collaboration participants come from matched author metadata or unique avatar-stack matches against the current complete catalog; names are not identities
explicit channel or Todos selection resets scroll; restoration, indexing, pagination and refresh completion preserve it

verification.liveBaseline: Authenticated channels page contained 118 channelRenderer entries, stable IDs, canonical handles and protocol-relative avatar URLs. Native feed scrolling appended 100 cards. JSON bootstrap has LOGGED_IN, DATASYNC_ID and INNERTUBE_CONTEXT. Sidebar exposed seven subscribed channel links and native newness dots. The reported public collaboration card used a two-image yt-avatar-stack-view-model with no exposed data property; its dialog confirmed two channel IDs.
verification.fixtures: Sanitized representative renderer/continuation structures; IDs, names, URLs and tokens are invented. No account credentials are stored.
verification.localBrowser: Earlier controller/carousel versions were checked in a temporary Chromium harness for themes, layout, arrows, filtering and native pagination.
verification.limitations: The indexed 1.6.2 filter is covered by bridge tests and a sanitized reproduction of the reported public collaboration card, including avatar-stack matching and channel switching without repeated owner reads. Installed-extension performance, authenticated continuation behavior, account switching and subscription-feed rendering still require browser verification.
